author: agent
text: Flag ownership is a TUPLE of commands, not one command. It was one owner per flag for a year, and `memway viz --force` - a flag printed in viz's own usage line - was rejected with "applies to 'pull' only" because pull claimed --force first. The deeper reason nothing caught it: the usage text lives in this module's docstring and the flag table lived inside main(), and no test compared them. VALUE_FLAGS/BOOL_FLAGS are now module-level SO THEY CAN BE READ BY A TEST; tests/test_cli_usage.py parses the flags back out of the shipped usage text (12 flags across 7 commands, parsed not hand-listed) and requires each to be receivable by the command it is printed under. Do not re-inline these tables into main(). Fixed 0.53.3, 2026-08-16.
